reviews.title: Very satisfied after more than a year of use
reviews.comment:
I’ve been using the MSI MAG B760 Tomahawk WiFi Gaming Motherboard for over a year now, and I’m extremely satisfied with it. The system has been running stable from day one with zero issues.
The build quality is excellent — solid PCB, good VRM cooling, and well-designed heatsinks. Even under heavy gaming and long workloads, temperatures stay perfectly under control. I’m running a high-performance Intel CPU, and the board handles it without any problems.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth have been reliable, connection is stable, and speeds are good. There are plenty of USB ports and M.2 slots, which made both the initial build and later upgrades very easy.
The BIOS is clean, intuitive, and easy to work with. Updates have been smooth, and MSI’s support has been solid so far. Overall, this motherboard feels durable, well-engineered, and built to last.
After more than a year of daily use, I can confidently say this is a great value motherboard
reviews.author: Anar

reviews.title: Solid motherboard
reviews.comment:
I bought this product because it was the cheapest and had everything I was looking for, ddr5, PCIE 5.0, wifi 6E. Etc. It felt solid. Had some weight to it. Felt good quality. No damaged pins. Everything in the box as it should have been.
Only a couple things to note
This motherboard could really use a bios flashback button, And a couple more PWM system fan headers.
Other than that
The boot process was seamless, booted right up and was able to install everything I needed with zero issues. Worked right out of the box with a 12th gen CPU (i5 12600k) my favorite feature about this board is the msi center hardware monitoring feature. It gives me peace of mind being able to keep an eye on my CPU and motherboard temps. Such as the socket and other temps.
Overall this is a very satisfying purchase for me being a first time builder. Will definitely go to msi again in the future for motherboards should I ever need to again.
reviews.author: No1inparticular

reviews.title: Great Motherboard for a New Build
reviews.comment: With so many motherboards to choose from, the Tomahawk stands out and provides great value through the included features, ease of assembly, and overall positive reviews. I like the modern/futureproofing features like being DDR5-ready, WiFi inclusion, numerous SATA connections, M2 slots with built in heat sinks, and overall it just looks good inside the case. As the backbone of the new PC, it was a relief that everything was so straightforward and easy to assemble. Had no trouble following along with the manual - it was all laid out step by step and I was able to move through the process fairly quickly. BIOS was intuitive and I was able to get going without a hitch. I wanted something that would last me long term without issues or struggles along the way and so far I’m quite happy with the result.
reviews.author: Zachary

reviews.title: Perfect for the reasonably price Gaming PC
reviews.comment:
Everything you need, and a decent price!
Perfect for that "budget" Gaming build!  3 NMVe slots, 4 RAM slots, built-in WiFi.  Works like a charm with Intel 13700K!  Dual booted Windows and Linux, and haven't had any driver issues!
reviews.author: Phill

reviews.title: Great MOBO!
reviews.comment: Great MOBO.  Well worth the $30 to upgrade to the DDR5 model.  You get: 2400 MHz higher RAM speed (max) - 5600MHz vs 3200MHz, 1667 MHz higher overclocked RAM speed - 7000MHz vs 5333MHz, 128GB larger maximum memory amount - 256GB vs 128GB, 1 more USB 3.0 ports (through expansion) 3 vs 2.  Plenty of fan headers, easy connectivity.  Perfect for my Intel Core i5-13600KF.
reviews.author: Jim L.
